title: Meta releases Muse Spark Open, an 816-billion-parameter open-weight model
friendlyTitle: Meta releases a very large open model for coding agents
summary: Hugging Face published Meta's Muse Spark Open on 15 October: an open-weight mixture-of-experts model with about 816 billion parameters, about 42 billion active per token, and a context window of up to one million tokens. It takes text, images, audio and video as input, generates text, and is aimed at long coding and agent tasks.
friendlySummary: Meta's Muse Spark Open is a free-to-download model with about 816 billion parameters, though only about 42 billion are used for each token. It can read text, pictures, audio and video, and it writes text. It is built for long coding jobs.
whyItMatters: Developers can inspect and adapt a frontier-scale open model instead of relying only on a closed API. The BF16 checkpoint is about 1.5 terabytes, so most people will use a hosted copy; this is not a laptop download.
friendlyWhyItMatters: You can study or adapt the model instead of using only a closed service. The full file is about 1.5 terabytes, so most people will use a hosted copy, not a laptop.
